description: Polymarket traders ranked by realized PnL and other stats over a window, with filters. Each row is an entity (one trader, possibly several wallets).

bands.description: unlock price bands to include, comma-separated: 0 = free … 5

limit.description: rows, at most 200 (rows count against a daily allowance of 20,000)

maxWallets.description: at most this many wallets in the entity

minCategoryShare.description: with category: at least this share (0–1] of the trader's volume in it

minEligible.description: floor on markets that count toward the win rate

minPnl.description: floor on realized PnL in USD

minVolume.description: floor on traded volume in USD

minWinLo.description: floor on the lower bound of the 95% win-rate interval (0–1): a win rate that is not luck

minWinsLosses.description: floor on markets won or lost

offset.description: rows to skip (signed-in accounts; anonymous callers see a fixed sample)

name: leaderboard
